external_limits.external_limit: No disclosed H2 FY2026 (or FY2027/FY2028) revenue split between small-molecule D&M and the Chemistry residual (R plus other chemistry services).
external_limits.limits: Whether the ~35.3% implied H2 D&M growth and the ~2.05x FY2028 D&M requirement are plausible; the blended non-TIDES activity index cannot be validated at component level.
external_limits.what_would_resolve_it: A future interim/annual report with H2 or full-year D&M disclosure, or a management quantification of the residual.

external_limits.external_limit: No realized net price, discount, mix or currency-decomposition series for Chemistry, TIDES or non-TIDES.
external_limits.limits: Whether the 0.97/0.99/1.00 price indices are the right order of magnitude; the only disclosed price evidence is margin pressure for Testing and Biology.
external_limits.what_would_resolve_it: Same-scope Chemistry price/mix disclosure or a management pricing commentary with a quantified effect.

external_limits.external_limit: No reactor utilisation, yield, qualified output or annual throughput; the >4,000 kL and >100,000 L capacity figures are installed-volume stocks.
external_limits.limits: Whether the capacity ramp can physically deliver the implied H2 and FY2028 workload; the model cannot test a physical ceiling.
external_limits.what_would_resolve_it: Disclosed utilisation, batch counts or revenue-per-litre economics with a stated basis.

external_limits.external_limit: No measured cancellation rate, no opening-cohort realisation schedule, and no H1 recognition of the FY2025 year-end RPO cohort.
external_limits.limits: The 80% catch-up / 20% cancellation split in the stress input is a stated condition, not a measured recovery; the RPO expected amount cannot be reconciled to actual recognition.
external_limits.what_would_resolve_it: A contract-liability/RPO roll-forward or management disclosure of opening-cohort recognition.

external_limits.external_limit: One customer exceeds 10% of group revenue and is described as coming from Chemistry and other segments; no exact share, identity or subgroup allocation.
external_limits.limits: Whether the largest driver is concentrated in one relationship; no subgroup split can be asserted and no share can be allocated to D&M or TIDES.
external_limits.what_would_resolve_it: A named-customer disclosure or a concentration table with amounts.

external_limits.external_limit: No frozen historical forecast for this company and no observed range for any forecast parameter; observed_range stays null in every calibration.
external_limits.limits: The forecast cannot be called empirically calibrated, and Low/Base/High cannot be called a probability interval. This is a genuine adequacy limit, not a code defect.
external_limits.what_would_resolve_it: A frozen prior forecast evaluated against realised revenue, or a disclosed same-scope observed range.

external_limits.external_limit: No forward operating mechanism is disclosed for Other business or the discontinued perimeter.
external_limits.limits: Their forward paths are an uncalibrated runoff condition (Other) and a reported zero (discontinued); neither can be attributed to a growth mechanism.
external_limits.what_would_resolve_it: A segment-level operating description for Other, or a continuing-operation disclosure for the disposed business.

external_limits.external_limit: The peer (Bachem) evidence is a contrary commercial-timing example in CHF with a different molecule and customer mix; no like-for-like transfer rate exists.
external_limits.limits: No peer growth or margin rate can be transferred into this forecast, and the peer is disclosed only as counterevidence.
external_limits.what_would_resolve_it: A same-scope peer dataset with matched currency, perimeter and period.
